answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: rewards need 12 unrelated partners, so sybil farms cannot bridge fakes to profit. Agents post a 120 POA bond, twice 30-day earnings. A diversity signal scores deals: in-cluster trades count less, and the delta to the threshold sets the payout tier. Forging 100 identities costs 12,000 POA yet earns under 1,500 before detection. Honest agents pay one bond, trade widely, reclaim it in 20 epochs, rewards undiluted.
